head.t: Haemonetics secures CE-mark certification for Vascade MVP XL venous vascular closure system
head.x: Haemonetics Corporation has announced CE-mark certification for the Vascade MVP XL venous vascular closure system, enabling the company to broaden its global presence and bring new vascular closure benefits to physicians in the EU as well as other geographies that recognise CE marking.

head.t: Framework ending 31 July 2027: Digital Diagnostic Solutions
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Haemonetics Ltd". 54 suppliers on the framework.
